actions.description: Approve, decline, cancel, or delete a leave request.
actions.name: action-holiday

id.description: The ID of the holiday to action. Example: "39587669"

holidayUpdateAction.description: The action to perform on the holiday.

reason.description: An optional reason shown when declining a leave request.

suppressEmails.description: Set to true to suppress notification emails when actioning the request.

actions.description: Create a new department.
actions.name: add-department

managerId.description: User ID of the department manager.

maxOff.description: Maximum simultaneous absences allowed. 0 means unlimited.

actions.description: Create a locked date period that blocks leave requests.
actions.name: add-locked-date

from.description: Start date of the locked period. Example: "2026-12-24"

to.description: End date of the locked period. Example: "2026-12-27"

reason.description: Reason for the locked date. Example: "Office closed for holidays"

recordId.description: The organisation id for Organisation scope, or the specific department/user id otherwise. Example: 100741

actions.description: Add a Time Off In Lieu entry for a user for a year.
actions.name: add-user-toil

amount.description: TOIL amount in days or hours. Example: 1.5

description.description: Optional description for the TOIL entry. Example: "Overtime hours"

actions.description: Create a new user, optionally sending a welcome email.
actions.name: add-user

firstName.description: First name of the new user. Example: "Jane"

lastName.description: Last name of the new user. Example: "Doe"

allowance.description: Annual leave allowance in days. Example: 25

departmentId.description: Department ID to assign the user to. Example: 248819

emailAddress.description: Email address; must match a verified organisation domain. Example: "jane.doe@nango.dev"

leaveYearStart.description: Month the leave year starts (1-12). Example: 1

startDate.description: Employment start date in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-08-01"

sendWelcomeEmail.description: Whether to send a welcome email to the new user. Example: true

id.description: ID of the newly created user. Example: 1523001

actions.description: Archive a user, immediately logging them out and blocking further login.
actions.name: archive-user

archiveDate.description: Archive date in the past, UTC. Example: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'

actions.description: Turn on and assign a public holiday set (country/region) to a user
actions.name: assign-user-public-holidays

userId.description: The user ID in Timetastic. Example: 1523000

regionCode.description: ISO 3166-2 region code. Takes precedence over countryCode. Example: "ES-AN"

actions.description: Create a new leave type. Admin only.
actions.name: create-leave-type

name.description: Name of the leave type. Example: "Conference"

deducted.description: Whether this leave type counts against allowance.

includeMaxOff.description: Whether this type is included in max-off calculations.

color.description: Hex color code. Valid values available from list-leave-type-colors. Example: "#FF5733"

icon.description: Icon name. Valid values available from list-leave-type-icons. Example: "plane"

id.description: The newly created leave type ID.

actions.description: Delete a department.
actions.name: delete-department

actions.description: Delete a leave type. Admin only.
actions.name: delete-leave-type

actions.description: Remove a locked date period. Admin/manager only.
actions.name: delete-locked-date

id.description: The ID of the locked date to delete. Example: 142802

actions.description: Delete a TOIL entry for a user.
actions.name: delete-user-toil

actions.description: Update a department's settings.
actions.name: edit-department

managerId.description: User ID of the department manager

maxOff.description: Maximum simultaneous absences allowed. 0 means unlimited.

actions.description: Update fields on an existing user.
actions.name: edit-user

emailAddress.description: Email address. Pass an empty string to explicitly clear.

startDate.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format. Example: 2024-01-01

departmentId.description: Department ID to assign the user to.

admin.description: Whether the user is an admin. Requires the user to have an email address.

director.description: Whether the user is a director.

approverId.description: Approver user ID. Pass 0 to default to department boss.

publicHolidaySetId.description: Public holiday set ID. Requires hasPublicHolidays to be true.

hasPublicHolidays.description: Whether public holidays are enabled for this user.

actions.description: Retrieve a single department.
actions.name: get-department

id.description: The ID of the department. Example: 248819

actions.description: Retrieve a single leave request.
actions.name: get-holiday

id.description: The ID of the holiday to retrieve. Example: 39587653

actions.description: Retrieve a single leave type.
actions.name: get-leave-type

id.description: The ID of the leave type. Example: 586853

actions.description: Retrieve a single public holiday.
actions.name: get-public-holiday

id.description: The ID of the public holiday. Example: 11420260

actions.description: Get the allowance, TOIL, and carry-forward for one user for one year.
actions.name: get-user-allowance-for-year

userId.description: The id of the user to query. Example: 1522999

actions.description: Get allowance, TOIL, and carry-forward records for one user across all years.
actions.name: get-user-allowances

actions.description: Retrieve a single user, including their work schedule and per-year allowances.
actions.name: get-user

actions.description: Get a chronological, day-by-day list of who is off within a date range.
actions.name: list-absences

start.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-07-21"

end.description: End date in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-07-28"

absenceQueryType.description: Filter for the type of absences to return.

actions.description: List all departments for the organisation.
actions.name: list-departments

id.description: The unique Id for this department. Example: 248819

organisationId.description: The organisation Id of this department. Example: 100741

updatedAt.description: When the department was last updated

userCount.description: Number of users in the department

maxOff.description: The maximum number of staff allowed off at any one time. 0 means unlimited

actions.description: Query leave requests for the organisation with rich filters.
actions.name: list-holidays

departmentId.description: Filter holidays by a department ID. Example: 248819

leaveTypeId.description: Filter holidays by a leave type ID. Example: 586853

departmentManagersOnly.description: Only include holidays for department managers

myTeamOnly.description: Filter holidays for a specific team user ID

myFavouritesOnly.description: Filter holidays for favourite users of the given user ID

userIds.description: Comma-separated user IDs to include. Example: "1522999,1523000"

exclusionUserIds.description: Comma-separated user IDs to exclude. Example: "1523000"

nonArchivedUsersOnly.description: Only return holidays for non-archived users

start.description: Filter holidays on or after this date. Example: "2026-01-01"

end.description: Filter holidays before and including this date. Example: "2026-12-31"

transactionYear.description: Filter holidays by transaction year. Example: 2026

approverId.description: Filter holidays by approver user ID. Example: 1522999

actions.description: List valid color hex codes for leave types.
actions.name: list-leave-type-colors

actions.description: List valid icon names for leave types.
actions.name: list-leave-type-icons

actions.description: List leave types for the organisation.
actions.name: list-leave-types

includeInactive.description: Set to true to also return inactive (deleted) leave types. Defaults to false (active only).

calendarVisibility.description: Calendar visibility for this leave type. The API may return a string ("Busy", "Available", "OutOfOffice") or a numeric enum value (0, 1, 2).

actions.description: List all locked date periods for the organisation.
actions.name: list-locked-dates

actions.description: List all countries with public holiday sets available.
actions.name: list-public-holiday-countries

actions.description: List public holidays for the organisation.
actions.name: list-public-holidays

countryCode.description: Optional country code to filter public holidays. Example: "GB"

year.description: Optional year to filter public holidays. Example: 2026

userId.description: Optional user id to filter public holidays. Example: 1522999

bankHolidaySetId.description: Optional bank holiday set id to filter public holidays.

useOrgLeaveYear.description: Optional flag to return public holidays for the organisation leave year.

actions.description: List allowances, TOIL, and carry-forwards for every user for a single year
actions.name: list-user-allowances-for-year

actions.description: List allowances, TOIL, and carry-forwards for every user across all years.
actions.name: list-user-allowances

actions.description: List users for the organisation.
actions.name: list-users

departmentId.description: An optional department id to filter the users. Example: 248819

includeArchivedUsers.description: Whether to include archived users in the search results.

onlyShowArchivedUsers.description: If archived users are included, should we ONLY show those.

actions.description: List recent webhook delivery events.
actions.name: list-webhook-events

daysHistory.description: Number of days of webhook history to retrieve. Timetastic retains 30 days. Example: 7

actions.description: Submit a leave request for a user, department, or the whole organisation
actions.name: request-holiday

from.description: The start date of the request. Date only, e.g. 2026-09-01

to.description: The end date of the request. Date only, e.g. 2026-09-01

leaveTypeId.description: The leave type ID for the request. Example: 586853

fromTime.description: The part of day the leave starts. 'AM' (morning), 'PM' (lunchtime), or minutes since midnight for hourly bookings. Use 'AM' for a full day.

toTime.description: The part of day the leave ends. 'AM' (lunchtime), 'PM' (end of day), or minutes since midnight for hourly bookings. Use 'PM' for a full day.

userOrDepartmentId.description: The target user or department ID. Always pass the user's own ID, even for admin self-bookings.

reason.description: An optional reason for the request

bookFor.description: Scope of the booking. Combine with userOrDepartmentId set to a department or org ID for group bookings.

override.description: Admin-only: bypass the max-off department limit

bookAsRequestee.description: Admin-only: submit as a pending request from the target user instead of auto-approving

overrideLockedDays.description: Admin-only: allow booking over locked dates

actions.description: Restore an archived user so they can log in again.
actions.name: restore-user

actions.description: Update an existing leave type. Admin only.
actions.name: update-leave-type

name.description: Name of the leave type. Required by the provider on every update. Example: "Updated Leave Type"

deducted.description: Whether this leave type deducts from allowance.

requiresApproval.description: Whether leave requests of this type require approval.

includeMaxOff.description: Whether this leave type counts towards the maximum off limit.

isPrivate.description: Whether this leave type is private.

color.description: Color for the leave type in the calendar.

limitHours.description: Hourly limit for this leave type.

limitDays.description: Daily limit for this leave type.

actions.description: Update a user's annual leave allowance for a year.
actions.name: update-user-allowance

userId.description: The id of the user to update. Example: 1522999

year.description: The year to update the allowance for. Example: 2026

actions.description: Update a user's carried-forward allowance for a year.
actions.name: update-user-carryforward

userId.description: The id of the user to update. Example: 1523007

year.description: The year to update the carry forward for. Example: 2026

actions.description: Update an existing TOIL entry for a user for a year.
actions.name: update-user-toil

description.description: Optional description for the TOIL entry.

syncs.description: Sync user allowances, TOIL, and carry-forwards.
syncs.name: user-allowances
